language_status.description: drift when any text drifted; else undecided when any text is undecided; else ok.

language_expected.description: The requested code, normalised (lowercase; nb -> no).

index.description: Position of the text in the input list.

detected.description: The detector's top guess (py3langid code). For a drift found by script alone, the language that script names on its own (Hangul: ko), else null (Arabic, Devanagari, Cyrillic: several languages).

confidence.description: Probability that the text is NOT in the expected language or a close variant of it; 1.0 for a drift found by script.

foreign_script.description: The first script in the text that the expected language does not use, title case ('Arabic', 'Devanagari', 'Cjk'), or null. Latin is never foreign (since 1.1).

language_issues.description: Texts confidently in another language, or with a word in a script the expected language does not use (since 1.1).
